WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT si.riskeval, AVG(1.0 * s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS group_avg
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN sites AS si ON CAST(si.zoneregistry AS BLOB) = CAST(s.zoneref AS BLOB)
  GROUP BY si.riskeval
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS overall_avg
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT AVG(g.group_avg) AS average_group_average,
       AVG(g.group_avg - o.overall_avg) AS average_excess_over_overall
FROM group_averages AS g
JOIN overall_average AS o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
WHERE g.group_avg > o.overall_avg
